non_descending_object: The UV-fiber selector: the trans-cutoff datum that picks the realized UV completion from the equivalence class of UV theories sharing one IR effective field theory. WHY IN NEITHER Sigma_f: rg_eft.Sigma_f explicitly excludes 'the UV completion above a given IR theory (non-definable from the IR, E009)' and the numerical VALUES of matched low-energy couplings when strongly coupled -- its vocabulary is relevant/marginal couplings, fixed points, anomalous dimensions, beta functions: all IR-fixed-point-equivalence-class data. relativistic_qft.Sigma_f is the cutoff-INDEPENDENT (RG-equivalence-class) renormalized correlator data and EXCLUDES any single fixed-cutoff fundamental object; it is itself only defined up to the RG class that the IR shadow records. So NEITHER endpoint's Sigma_f contains a predicate that distinguishes two distinct UV completions that flow to the SAME renormalized IR data. The selector is the distinction BETWEEN members of the down-projection fiber -- exactly the information the IR coarse-graining throws away. OBJECT KIND: a fiber-distinguishing predicate / branch label, NOT a value-readout (it is not 'the proton mass' style E0 run-target; it is the principle that SELECTS among non-descending UV branches). RELATION TO THE E008 MIRROR: E008 (relativistic_qft -> rg_eft, shadow-down, form_tier E1) certifies the DOWN projection factorizes (Xi -> 0 for the RG mode-elimination structure). The non-descending object is precisely the kernel of that projection read as content: the equivalence classes 'two UV theories identified in rg_eft.Sigma_f' that the realized-UV layer would distinguish. Non-factorization of E009 = the down-map of E008 is many-to-one.
required_lens_predicates: A lens that resolves the FIBER of the RG-IR projection: predicates distinguishing two UV theories that share an IR effective Lagrangian (e.g. which heavy states, which symmetry-breaking pattern, which global/gauge structure UV-completes the same IR operators).

Consistency-of-UV-completion predicates (the structural content the conventional 'swampland' program tries to name): unitarity/causality/positivity bounds, anomaly-cancellation and global-symmetry constraints that a candidate UV theory must satisfy to be an admissible completion -- these are constraints the layer L must CARRY, not constraints SBT can derive.

A matching/decoupling predicate: how UV degrees of freedom integrate out to produce the IR matching coefficients (the inverse of E008's mode-elimination), including the run-only matched-coupling VALUES (the E008 value_split E0 leg) as a SEPARATE deferred sub-target.

A SELECTION predicate over the admissible-completion set: even after consistency-filtering, which completion is realized. The atlas's E037 (string -> SM) shows this predicate is itself foreclosed (the ~10^500-vacuum landscape) -- so L must carry a selection SLOT, but SBT is silent on its content.

Idempotence/closure check that L coarse-grains DOWN to relativistic_qft (and onward to rg_eft) by the audited E008 shadow -- i.e. L must reproduce the known IR shadow as its own descent, or it is not a faithful parent.

relation_to_endpoints.is_an_endpoint_a_shadow_of_L: YES. relativistic_qft (as a fixed RG-equivalence class / IR-anchored framework) is a SHADOW (down/definable descent) of the deeper UV-completion substrate L. rg_eft is a shadow of relativistic_qft (E008). So both endpoints are shadows of L at successive coarse-graining depths.

divergence.verdict: partial -- CONTESTED (audit: divergence_holds=true but adversarial_survival=2.5). The CORE foreclosure (emergence-up, E3, non-definable from the IR) is genuinely casting-robust and survives. The HEADLINE divergence ('selection, not mere completion') does NOT survive as a field-redirecting discovery: it is largely a RESTATEMENT of the accepted landscape/swampland/vacuum-selection problem (convention already knows supplying a UV completion does not close vacuum selection -- so the divergence is against a mild strawman), and its grounding is partly CIRCULAR (E037 is used both to build the divergence AND as its claimed out-of-sample confirmation). Honest status: SBT here RECOVERS/REFRAMES a known open problem rather than diverging from real convention; the finer selection-on-a-fiber claim is firm-but-testable, conditional on charting E015-inverse, NOT established.
divergence.conventional_candidate: A UV completion -- asymptotic safety, string theory, or new high-energy degrees of freedom -- supplied above the EFT.
divergence.explanation: The conventional candidate correctly identifies the LOCATION and DIRECTION of the hole (above the EFT, in the UV, an emergence-up / non-definable-from-IR object) -- SBT's E009 = emergence-up / E3 AGREES with that. Where it PARTIALLY DIVERGES: the conventional framing treats 'supply a UV completion' as CLOSING the gap, whereas the atlas's own internal evidence shows that supplying the leading concrete UV completion (string theory) does NOT close it but RELOCATES the identical foreclosure to a SELECTION problem (E037: string -> SM is itself E3 / emergence-up, the ~10^500-vacuum landscape, non-definable from below, no run or named principle selects OUR vacuum). So SBT's characterization is sharper than 'a UV completion is missing': the missing STRUCTURE is a selection principle on the UV-completion fiber, and the conventional candidates are admissible CANDIDATE-substrates for that structure but are NOT themselves the closure -- each inherits the same non-factorization one level up. FIREWALL HEDGE (load-bearing): the headline divergence is downgraded to CONTESTED. (a) It is largely a RESTATEMENT of the accepted landscape/swampland/vacuum-selection problem -- convention does not actually claim closure on mere supply, so the comparator is a mild strawman; honestly, SBT RECOVERS/REFRAMES a known open problem here. (b) Its grounding is partly CIRCULAR: E037 cannot both BUILD the divergence (as atlas_internal_evidence) and CONFIRM it out-of-sample. The only genuinely held-out, falsifiable test (E015-inverse, qed -> electroweak_theory) is NOT YET CHARTED, so the redirecting claim currently rests on in-sample evidence plus a strawman. Read the OTHER way, the finding is simply that the conventional candidates are correctly-typed candidate substructures whose own selection layer is still foreclosed -- a flagged finding about the SHAPE (selection, not mere completion), not a claim the conventional physics is wrong.

audit.verdict: CONTESTED -- casting-robust core, but the headline 'divergence' is a circular/near-restatement finding, not a field-redirecting discovery. WHAT SURVIVES: The structural core is sound and honest. The foreclosure (emergence-up, E3, non-definable from the IR) is genuinely casting-robust (both endpoint cards confirm E009 stays E3 under any formulation; E008's clean down-factorization makes E009's up non-factorization real, not a modeling artifact). The non-descending object (UV-fiber selector = kernel-content of the E008 many-to-one projection) is correctly identified as emergence-up and cleanly separated from the matched-coupling VALUE leg (E008's E0 value_split). Anti-reductionism §9 is honored throughout: no derive-across-layers, up/down asymmetry kept (E009 non-runnable, E008 runnable-down), foreclosure treated as the framework working, primer §4 (iteration saturates; only package change reaches the fiber) correctly invoked, and the card explicitly refuses to mis-cast this as F51 common-refinement. NO content overclaim: remains_unknown_content disclaims naming the theory; string/asymptotic-safety/new-dof are listed only as candidate substrates. WHAT FAILS: The advertised payload -- the 'partial divergence' that the author hopes is field-redirecting -- does NOT survive as a discovery. (a) It is largely a RESTATEMENT of the accepted landscape/swampland/vacuum-selection problem; convention already knows supplying a UV completion does not close vacuum selection, so 'selection not mere completion' diverges from a strawman, not from real convention. (b) Its grounding is CIRCULAR: E037 is used both to build the divergence AND as its claimed out-of-sample confirmation; the one genuinely held-out, falsifiable test (E015-inverse, qed->electroweak_theory, predicting E2-named-import for a small fiber) is admittedly NOT YET CHARTED. So the redirecting claim currently rests on in-sample evidence plus a strawman comparator. Per the discipline, a motivated divergence whose confirmation is circular and whose content is already textbook must be downgraded -- this is 'casting-dependent / contested', reframing a known open problem, NOT a discovery. The card is honest about its hedges (confidence 'firm-but-testable', 'not a claim conventional physics is wrong'), which is why it survives at 2.5 rather than lower; but the firewall does not pass as field-redirecting.
